total_model.summary: Model projects 43.6 total points (CHI 24, TB 19). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.3), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 0.6), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
